draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.68, the 223rd-best grade among 261 2022 draftees and 19th of 25 at LB. He went 193rd overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (223rd): teams liked him more than the published grade. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 95 tackles in 2021, 11th of 25 LBs in his class with stats.
